value.rationale: The primary iff characterizes all finite connected base graphs whose ordinary subdivisions have three-step extinction under a fixed natural update, a graph-theoretic rigidity classification. The converse odd-order family has an explicit nontrivial swap subsystem and all orbit and basin counts. General existence results do not expose this structural distinction; the invariant is canonical rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
